text:
Nina Patel: quick q — for the upcoming compliance export, how do we want to show 'who changed what' when the actor is a service account or an automated rollout?
Jorge Ramirez: include actor_type (human|service|system), actor_id, and a resolution field that maps to a human name when available. important for audits to know if change was automated.
Priya Shah: agree. one more: avoid dumping raw PII in the "old_value"/"new_value" fields. we should support redaction modes in the export: none, partial, tokenize. partial = mask emails/ssns etc.
Olivia Chen: UX: in the console timeline we should collapse long diffs and show a "view full diff" modal. export should keep full detail but honor redaction mode. can we keep a small preview in the timeline? maybe first 200 chars.
Jorge Ramirez: on storage/transport: NDJSON makes sense for streaming consumers. each line = event envelope + diff payload. we should add a top-level metadata block per file with export criteria (time range, redaction, actor resolution mode).
Nina Patel: thanks — does anyone have concerns about signing or tamper-evidence for downloads? security asked for integrity proof for offline archive retrieval.
Priya Shah: +1. propose we support optional signed bundles (detached signature) and include a manifest.json with sha256 for each ndjson file. keeps export consumer workflow simple.
Olivia Chen: console flow: user clicks Export -> choose range / actor filters / redaction -> preview counts -> request -> notification when ready with link. link should expire + include who requested it in audit log.
Jorge Ramirez: API sketch for triggering export:
```
POST /v1/audit/exports
{
  "since": "2024-05-01T00:00:00Z",
  "until": "2024-05-07T00:00:00Z",
  "redaction": "partial",
  "actor_resolution": "map_if_human",
  "sign_bundle": true
}
```
returns job id + estimated size.
Priya Shah: small note on redaction: partial should be deterministic so QA/eval can diff across exports. tokenization needs stable tokens per tenant, otherwise you can't track the same actor across exports.
Nina Patel: good catch. stable salt per tenant is necessary for tokenization mode. add to design doc.
eng-sre-bot: export-job-238712: exporter finished (size: 1.2GB, files: 3). link expires in 72h.
Olivia Chen: UX question — should we show an inline "why was this redacted" tooltip on each masked field? helps reviewers and auditors.
Jorge Ramirez: yes — embed metadata in each event like "redaction_reason": "pii_masked" and a schema version tag. UI can map codes to human text.
Priya Shah: and add a flag for "sensitive_field_type": ["email","ssn","credit_card"] so downstream SIEMs can apply rules.
Nina Patel: action items: (1) Jorge draft NDJSON envelope + manifest schema, (2) Priya add deterministic tokenization & redaction modes doc, (3) Olivia wire console flow + preview counts, (4) Security to confirm signature format. I'll create a PR for the spec and link here.
Olivia Chen: I'll mock the preview UI by EOD and attach screenshots.
Jorge Ramirez: starting schema draft now, will ping when ready.
Priya Shah: I'll write the redaction appendix and include examples.
Nina Patel: awesome — thanks all. tagging security for visibility @security (leave feedback on PR) :thumbsup:
